# Episode Summary
This episode covers three major developments shaping enterprise AI adoption: Anthropic's new Claude for Small Business tier, which targets companies too large for free tools but lacking enterprise infrastructure; Databricks' expanded Unity Catalog with attribute-based access control and automated data classification, addressing the governance bottlenecks holding back regulated industry AI deployment; and Clio's achievement of $500M in annual recurring revenue, demonstrating that vertical AI has matured enough to drive massive ROI in traditionally conservative fields like law.
